lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign across 2 tests, while another 2 tests made adoption worse.
No effect was seen for finish new_screen in 1 test, while 1 test made finish worse.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, and sign_in notification, as each has only 1 test.

candidates.title: Path Selection Orientation Screen
candidates.change: Inserts an orientation preview screen before choose_path that highlights what adoption paths offer.
candidates.why: choose_path has a mean duration of 514s, showing users hesitate before selecting a path.

new_path_orientation.headline: Explore Companion Paths
new_path_orientation.body: Choose between predefined friendly pets or create a custom companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Adding an orientation screen before path selection is a valid addition within onboarding and keeps all mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding orientation screens typically adds friction and lacks support ticket evidence.

candidates.title: Sign In Session Sync Notification
candidates.change: Triggers a notification during sign-in informing users that logging in locks their pet data to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in syncs and secures your pet across devices automatically.

guard.reason: Adding a sync notification setting to sign-in is allowed inside onboarding without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Proven historically positive change (+8.0% noise corrected) backed by 8 support complaints.

candidates.title: Sign In Cloud Backup Hint
candidates.change: Displays a hint text under sign-in options explaining that signing in prevents pet loss.
candidates.why: 8 user complaints focused on reset or missing pets after sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Your account keeps your desktop pet saved safely so you never lose progress.

guard.reason: Adding hint text explaining cloud backup on sign-in is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text hint addressing 8 pet-reset support complaints.

candidates.title: Pet Matchmaker Guided Selection Flow
candidates.change: Adds a guided quick matchmaker quiz screen right before pick_friend to help users pick a pet based on play style.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a median time of 89s.

new_pet_matchmaker.headline: Find Your Ideal Pet
new_pet_matchmaker.body: Answer two quick questions to see which pet best fits your desktop vibe.

guard.reason: Adding a matchmaker quiz sub-flow before friend selection is permitted and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop step, but adoption new_flow previously reduced target step conversion by -5.7%.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Structured Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Changes the upload photos screen layout to checklist format to guide clear photo requirements.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption drops to 60.9%.

upload_photos.headline: Photo Upload Requirements
upload_photos.hint: Ensure clear lighting and a single subject for optimal pet generation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen layout to a checklist keeps the screen's core job intact.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest funnel drop and pet generation support tickets, though layout changes have mixed results.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Completion Time Estimate Info
candidates.change: Adds a progress bar and remaining time estimate to the waiting screen while generation runs.
candidates.why: Home step median time is 201s with a mean of 2336s, indicating long unguided waits.

waiting.hint: Creating your pet assets. This usually takes under two minutes.

guard.reason: Displaying a time estimate and progress bar for a real wait period during asset generation is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost indicator targeting very long wait times during pet generation.

candidates.title: Generation Progress Mascot Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Inserts an interactive mascot preview screen during pet generation to teach basic desktop interactions.
candidates.why: Users take up to 2336s on home wait step and 3 support tickets reported confusion over controlling pets.

new_mascot_showcase.headline: While You Wait: Desktop Companion Tips
new_mascot_showcase.body: Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Click and drag them anywhere or right-click for options.

components.text: I will appear on your screen shortly!

guard.reason: Inserting a mascot showcase tip screen during/after pet generation is a valid onboarding addition.

candidates.score_note: Supported by user confusion tickets, but inserting new screens into home has historically yielded negative lift.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split View Desktop Guide Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout with explicit desktop controls on the right.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received multiple queries on how to control or hide pets post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Is Ready!
home_intro.body: Check your desktop. Use the taskbar icon or direct clicks to interact.

home_welcome.text: Control guide: Left-click to interact, right-click menu to hide or customize.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout and copy is allowed since home intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop step and control confusion, but finish screen redesigns have historically regressed.

candidates.title: Desktop Taskbar Control Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the finish screen explaining how to access the pet options menu in the system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported users being confused about how to hide, control, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click the pet tray icon anytime to open commands or hide your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adding a taskbar control hint to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint directly addressing user control support tickets on a high-loss step.

candidates.title: Choose Path Before Story Introductory Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders the onboarding sequence to place path selection immediately at launch before the story screen.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time is 514s; presenting choice first lets users pick their preferred path early.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move
